per_question.question: How many days of annual leave does a permanent employee accrue per year at Zidipay?
per_question.answer: Permanent employees at Zidipay accrue 24 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year, accrued at 2 days per month worked [2].
per_question.gold_answer: Permanent employees accrue 24 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year, at 2 days per month.

per_question.question: How many days of annual leave can be carried over into the next year and by when must they be used?
per_question.answer: Up to 5 days of unused annual leave can be carried over into the next year and must be used by 31 March [1]. Any carried-over days unused by this date are forfeited, unless written approval for carry-over beyond 5 days is granted by the Head of People [1].
per_question.gold_answer: Up to 5 unused days may be carried into the next calendar year and must be used by 31 March.
